title: SR-W-03A A red run whose TAP header was cut off is red only when an assertion is visible (memev)
request: Programme contract SR-W-03A in memev: a red run whose TAP header was cut off is judged on its assertion (work package WP22-01). It is additive to the signed SR-0.03.3 and does not supersede it: no criterion of SR-0.03.3 changes, and the one file it changes is src/engine/contracts.mjs, which the scope of T3 of SR-0.03.3 already names. Proposed and unsigned; the signer signs it after the red-team gate. The id is in the style of SO-W-08B: its second part starts with a letter, so the redteam gate's specIdOf reads the whole name and the contract has its own record path; the work package number 22 is not in docs/scope-one/programme/fragments. Why: the red stage of Vault.contractVerify calls notAnAssertion (src/engine/contracts.mjs, about lines 160 to 167 at the base), which returns null when the output has no 'TAP version' line. A criterion command that cuts the output with a tail or a head removes that line, so its red run counts as red even when it was a load error. SR-0.03.3 says a load error or a type error is BLOCKED (T3 criteria 3, 7 and 10) and that the red half must fail on an assertion (T3 criterion 13). A read-only replay of every red run of the signed criteria at main commit 5903c27 found 54 criteria whose red output had no header and whose exit was not 0: 45 load errors, 1 failure that was not an assertion, 3 silent runs and 5 genuine assertion failures. What changes (every other path of contractVerify stays as it is): (1) output with a 'TAP version' line is judged as today. (2) Output with no such line whose body is TAP-shaped (a line 1..N, a line '# tests N', '# pass N' or '# fail N', or a line 'ok N - ' or 'not ok N - ', each possibly indented) counts as red only when code: 'ERR_ASSERTION' or name: 'AssertionError' is visible in it, and is otherwise BLOCKED with a detail that says the TAP output has no header and shows no failing assertion, so the failure cannot be judged. (3) Output with no such line that is not TAP-shaped (pytest, cargo, jest, plain shell, nothing at all) is judged exactly as today. Boundaries: (a) the literal rule 'no header means BLOCKED' is not asked for: it broke test/contracts-worktree-concurrent.test.mjs and test/contracts-worktree-lifecycle.test.mjs, whose red commands are plain shell, and 17 signed pytest, cargo and jest criteria. (b) A red run that prints nothing is not made BLOCKED here: a rule keyed to the text of the command (node --test) also catches the red command of those two tests, which ends in node --test {test} after a silent exit, and 3 signed criteria of QL-1.01 (T2 criteria 11 to 13); it is an open follow-up in docs/scope-one/RECONCILIATION.md. (c) Recording a base at signing is the separate contract QL-W-01A. (d) Removing the tail from the commands of existing specs belongs to each spec's author. Base revision: ba24c82e16c91f5962f20d49b396d46054a505da, the memev main commit that merged pull request #358; it is the commit the red runs of this contract are judged at, and the signer drafts with --workdir at the checkout top level and --base this commit (criterion 10 pins it). No production caller beyond verify itself: this is engine code that Vault.contractVerify already calls; no export is added. The tests reach the evaluator only through Vault.contractVerify; if an export is added anyway, the test imports it with import() inside the test body, so a missing export fails on an assertion and not at load. Depends on contracts: SR-0.03.3 (signed). Owner decisions of 31 Oct 2026 apply: crdt-merge stays in its own repository; tiers are free core, Personal at $12/month or $120/year for up to 3 computers, and contact us above that; there is no Federated tier. Nothing in this contract decides ADR 3, ADR 5, ADR 7 or SO-A-05.

tasks.title: A red run whose TAP header was cut off is red only when an assertion is visible, and every other kind of output is judged as before
requirements: notAnAssertion(out) keeps its result for any output that has a line starting TAP version: a visible code: 'ERR_ASSERTION' or name: 'AssertionError' is red, a load error (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND, SyntaxError, Cannot find module, does not provide an export named) is BLOCKED as 'load error', any other named error before an assertion is BLOCKED naming it (source: src/engine/contracts.mjs, notAnAssertion at the base)

for output with no TAP version line whose body is TAP-shaped (a line matching 1..N, a line '# tests N', '# pass N' or '# fail N', or a line 'ok N - ' or 'not ok N - ', each possibly indented), notAnAssertion returns null (red) only when code: 'ERR_ASSERTION' or name: 'AssertionError' is visible, and otherwise returns a reason saying that the TAP output has no header and shows no failing assertion, so the failure cannot be judged; verify then gives BLOCKED with the detail 'the red run did not fail on an assertion (<reason>); red exit N, green exit M, base <sha>' (source: SR-0.03.3 T3 criteria 3, 7, 10 and 13)

for output with no TAP version line that is not TAP-shaped (the output of pytest, cargo, jest, a plain shell command, or nothing), notAnAssertion returns null exactly as at the base, so such a red run is judged by its exit code alone as before

nothing else changes: the exit, timeout, size and exit-127 handling of the red and green runs, the green stage, passingLine, runCriterion and the NODE_OPTIONS handling, the scope and metric verifiers, and the output of the red-team gate; no export is added

the new test file reaches the engine only through Vault.contractVerify, and each red-green criterion of this task runs only its own subtest, whose name starts with T1-cNN: (NN is the criterion's position in this task, so T1-c01: for the first) (source: the convention of SR-0.03.3 T1 requirement 8)
tasks.description: Repo: memev. Depends on nothing that is not on main: SR-0.03.3 is signed and its red-green verifier is in src/engine/contracts.mjs at the base. A change of the red stage of the evaluator only; it adds no export and no caller. The fixtures are plain git repositories built by test/helpers/redgreen.mjs; the cut-header cases use a criterion command that drops the first line of a node --test TAP run, and the body-shape cases use a command that prints a canned output committed at the base and exits 1, and prints a passing line once the head's marker file exists.

criteria.statement: A TAP run whose header was cut (a command that keeps its exit code and drops the first line) is BLOCKED, with a detail that says the red run did not fail on an assertion and that the TAP output has no header, when the base run failed on a missing module and when it failed on a syntax error; the same cut run is PASS with the detail 'red exit 1, green exit 0, base <sha>' when it failed on an assertion. The test fails before the change (the load-error cases are PASS) on an assertion, not on a load error, and passes after

Output with no header and a TAP body is BLOCKED (same detail) when it holds only a plan (1..1), only count lines (# tests 1, # pass 0, # fail 1), only a not ok line, or only an indented not ok line, and is PASS when the same body also shows code: 'ERR_ASSERTION' or name: 'AssertionError'; a tail that cut off the assertion as well, leaving only the count lines, is BLOCKED. The test fails before the change on an assertion and passes after

Output that is not TAP is judged as before: a pytest-like, a cargo-like, a jest-like and a plain shell red output, with text and with none, each give PASS with the detail 'red exit 1, green exit 0, base <sha>'; and a TAP run that kept its header is unchanged (a load error is BLOCKED with 'load error', an assertion is PASS). This holds before and after the change
test/contracts-worktree-concurrent.test.mjs and test/contracts-worktree-lifecycle.test.mjs, whose red commands are plain shell, stay green
The red-green, scope, base and gate tests of the evaluator stay green

verifier.cmd: node --test test/contracts-redgreen.test.mjs test/contracts-redgreen-spurious.test.mjs test/contracts-redgreen-wrongred.test.mjs test/contracts-redgreen-wrongred2.test.mjs test/contracts-redgreen-green.test.mjs test/contracts-redgreen-paths.test.mjs test/contracts-base.test.mjs test/contracts-base-legacy.test.mjs test/contracts-gates.test.mjs test/redteam-gate.test.mjs

criteria.statement: The gate --report is byte-identical with and without the change: run on the same contracts tree, once with src, scripts and vendor as they are and once with them restored from the base, the two outputs do not differ

verifier.cmd: h=$(mktemp -d) && b=$(mktemp -d) && git worktree add -q --detach "$h" HEAD && git worktree add -q --detach "$b" HEAD && git -C "$b" checkout -q "$MEMEV_CONTRACT_BASE" -- src scripts vendor && (cd "$h" && node scripts/gate/redteam-gate.mjs --report > "$h.out" 2>&1); (cd "$b" && node scripts/gate/redteam-gate.mjs --report > "$b.out" 2>&1); diff "$h.out" "$b.out"; rc=$?; git worktree remove --force "$h"; git worktree remove --force "$b"; exit $rc

criteria.statement: One full run of test/contracts-cut-header.test.mjs passes every labelled subtest (T1-c01, T1-c02, T1-c03) with nothing skipped and nothing todo, and prints its whole output.

verifier.cmd: f=$(mktemp) && node --test --test-reporter=tap test/contracts-cut-header.test.mjs > "$f" 2>&1; rc=$?; cat "$f"; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && grep -Eq '^# skipped 0$' "$f" && grep -Eq '^# todo 0$' "$f" && grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*ok [0-9]+ - T1-c01:' "$f" && grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*ok [0-9]+ - T1-c02:' "$f" && grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*ok [0-9]+ - T1-c03:' "$f"

criteria.statement: src/engine/contracts.mjs says in a comment that output with no header is judged on a visible assertion when its body is TAP-shaped
The change adds no export and touches no other file of src, scripts or vendor, and the test file has no static import of the engine

verifier.cmd: test -z "$(git diff "$MEMEV_CONTRACT_BASE" HEAD -- src/engine/contracts.mjs | grep -E '^\+export ')" && test -z "$(git diff --name-only "$MEMEV_CONTRACT_BASE" HEAD -- src scripts vendor | grep -vx src/engine/contracts.mjs)" && ! grep -Eq "^import .*src/engine" test/contracts-cut-header.test.mjs

criteria.statement: This contract is drafted with the memev checkout as its workdir and a pinned base. The workdir is the checkout top level (git rev-parse --show-toplevel equals the working directory). The base is ba24c82e16c91f5962f20d49b396d46054a505da, the memev main commit that merged pull request #358 (SO-F-03), the commit the red runs are judged at.
The leak scan passes on files

stop_rules: No weakening of an existing test, no raised timeout, no skip, no widened scope; if blocked, report what blocks and continue with the next independent task.
A criterion that cannot be checked from this repository is reported as unchecked, never marked as passing.
Anything outside the requirements of this task is not built, not stubbed and not defaulted in code; if the work seems to need it, stop and report what it needs.
A test_red_green command of this contract prints its whole output: it is never piped through tail or head, and never captures its output without printing it.
